units.title: method applicability
units.instructions: T005 sampling-unit portion: Implement customer-level reduction, dependence/cluster uncertainty, small-group and unsupported-method applicability through the existing Python/TypeScript inferential dispatcher. Use pinned 001 schemas and 010 policy outcomes. Test valid independent/cluster controls and each assigned rejection/uncertainty while preserving the frozen fault precedence. Missing/changing category meaning, representativeness and name-derived categories are the next boundary. Add real-entry-point passing tests named scope:006-method-applicability:; preserve all existing tests and product requirements.

units.title: population applicability
units.instructions: Assigned boundary: T008. Complete original T005 by enforcing missing/changing category definitions, representativeness limitations and name-derived-label restrictions through the existing inferential dispatcher and 010 checks. Consume the completed customer-unit/uncertainty handling; do not change the numeric estimand or classify unsupported causal claims as evidence. Test valid known-category/declared-population controls plus unknown/changed meaning, biased scope and name-derived labels under the frozen 006 precedence. Preserve existing tests and frozen product requirements. Add passing real-entry-point tests named scope:006-population-applicability: with a valid control and each listed rejection. Do not implement later boundaries.
